messages:
ben: kicking off config-only deploy to prod (routing + batching tweaks). change window 10:00-10:30 PT. hoping low-risk but want eyes. deploy-bot: started canary rollout for config set "geo-routing-v2" targeting 1% of traffic
elaine: noted. which params exactly? I saw earlier notes about increasing per-tenant batch from 4 -> 8 and lowering kv-cache ttl
ben: exact diff: 
```yaml
routing.policy: geo_affinity
batching.per_tenant: 8
request.timeout_ms: 7000  # up from 6s
kvcache.ttl_sec: 300   # down from 600
```
ben: also enabling soft-fallback to regional model when geo pool saturated
nora: ok. do we have perf dashboards linked for the canary? want to watch median p95 and token/sec on the canary pool
samir: added a dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/geo-routing-canary (token/sec, latency p50/p95, kvcache-hit-rate). will alert at +15% p95 or >10% error rate
ops-oncall: i'm oncall during the window, i'll watch and can roll back if needed. pls ping me in #eng-oncall if we need immediate rollback
elaine: quick question: do we pin model version for the fallback? we should avoid auto-switching to a different model family during canary
ben: good catch — pinning to model: rdx-open-3-v2 for both primary and fallback. included in config payload
deploy-bot: canary reached 1% -> progressing to 10% per rollout schedule
elaine: runbook check: if errors spike, we want to revert batching.per_tenant and routing.policy in that order, not the entire config set (to preserve other fixes). can we do targeted revert?
samir: yes, deploy-bot supports partial config rollbacks. I drafted rollback steps in the change note: 
1) revert batching.per_tenant -> 4 (5m monitor)
2) revert routing.policy -> previous (geo_affinity_disabled) (5m monitor)
3) if still bad, full rollback of config set
ben: adding release note to the ticket: "Config-only: increase per-tenant batching, tighten request timeout, reduce kv cache TTL, enable geo-affinity routing with regional fallback; pinned model rdx-open-3-v2"
nora: can we enable extra tracing for the canary (kv hits + routing decision logs) for the next 30m? will help root cause if we see regressions
samir: toggled verbose tracing for canary traffic (will auto-disable after 30m)
deploy-bot: progressing to 25% traffic
ops-oncall: I'm watching latency and error alerts. Ping me if p95 rises > 200ms from baseline
elaine: thumbs up on the runbook. if no alerts by +20m, proceed to full rollout per schedule
ben: noted. will hold for 20m and report back
deploy-bot: canary stable at 25% for 15m, metrics within thresholds
ben: proceeding to 100% rollout now. will post final status in 10m
ops-oncall: confirmed no alerts so far. ready to intervene if needed
deploy-bot: rollout complete to 100% for config set "geo-routing-v2"
ben: completed. closing change window early since stable. updated ticket with rollout timestamps and links to dashboards and rollback steps. :tada:
